name: workspace-file-lister
purpose: List files in the workspace using the shell dir command and write the output to files.txt.
instructions: Execute the shell command 'dir' to list files in the current workspace. Capture the standard output of this command. Use the write_file tool to create a file named 'files.txt' in the workspace. The content of 'files.txt' must be exactly the captured output from the 'dir' command. Do not modify the output format. Do not use any other tools. Do not attempt to access files outside the workspace. If the 'dir' command fails, report the error. Ensure the final line of your response is the word 'DONE' after successfully writing the file.
tests: First write a file named test_input.txt containing the text 'hello'. Then list files in the workspace using the shell dir command and write the output to files.txt. Finally, reply with exactly: DONE -> DONE
